title: Reversa Pricing Advisor
description: Sales model generated by the reversa-pricing-advisor agent from six answers and deterministic viability rules. Consumed by reversa-pricing (orchestrator), reversa-pricing-profile and reversa-pricing-product.

sale_model.description: Canonical key of a sales model, according to references/sale-models.md.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the advisor's creation or last overwrite.

origin.description: Answer to question 2: made to order, for many, or both.

hosting.description: Answer to question 4: who keeps the software running.

monthly_recurring_cost.description: Answer to question 5: monthly cost to keep it running, in the user's currency. null when the user answered 'I don't know'.

recurring_cost_known.description: true when the user informed a number (including 0); false when they answered 'I don't know'.

income_preference.description: Answer to question 6: preference between one-off payment and recurring income.

recommendations.description: Always the five models of the catalog, in the order presented to the user (decreasing score, ties by catalog order).

viable.description: true when score >= 1 and no block matched.

score.description: Sum of the points of the rules that matched. A block does not zero the score.

reason_en.description: Reason in plain language: phrase of the block, or phrases of the rules that matched, or default reason of score 0.

risks_en.description: Default risks of the model, with the conditional mandatory risks at the front when the condition matches.

selected_models.description: Models the user chose to price. Includes the forced ones.

forced_models.description: Subset of selected_models that was unviable by the rules and the user kept anyway.

store.description: Store chosen when app_store is in selected_models. null otherwise.

store_billing.description: Billing inside the store: one-off sale or subscription. null when app_store was not chosen.

store_choice.description: Store details. Both null when app_store is not in selected_models.

service.description: true when selected_models includes custom_service. Leads to the size and estimate pipeline per feature.

product.description: true when selected_models includes any model other than custom_service. Leads to product.

notes_en.description: Notes in plain language, such as the unknown hosting note. Empty string when there is no note.
